title: An embedded triangular presentation with fraction representations
statement: Let $k$ and $K$ be fields [def-weil-field] with a $k$-algebra structure [def-pc-field-extension], suppose $K=k(b_0,\ldots,b_{m-1})$ for a finite family, and let $x:\operatorname{Fin}(d)\to K$ be a transcendence basis [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis]. There exist $r\geq0$, a nonzero $h\in k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d-1}]$, and monic polynomials $p_i\in k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d+i}][Z]$ ($0\leq i<r$; monic means leading coefficient one) such that, for the explicit list $f$ of [def-weil-pbc-triangular-field-model-equations], the quotient $A=k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d+r}]/(f)$ admits an injective $k$-algebra map $\iota:A\to K$ and every $z\in K$ equals $\iota(a)\iota(s)^{-1}$ for some $a,s\in A$ with $s\ne0$. No regularity claim is made.

proof.text: Take the finite family b supplied by hfg. Apply the triangular evaluation-kernel lemma to x and b, giving h, monic p_i, the variable values y and the equality ker(aeval y) = I for I the ideal of the explicit list.

proof.text: Use Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ to descend evaluation to the quotient by I. The kernel equality kills I and gives injectivity by RingHom.lift_injective_of_ker_le_ideal. Each b_i is the evaluation of X_(d+1+i), so Algebra.adjoin k (range b) is contained in the evaluation range.

proof.text: The hypothesis adjoin k (range b) = top and IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_iff_div express each z in K as a/s with a and s in Algebra.adjoin k (range b). If s = 0 then z = 0; use quotient numerator 0 and denominator 1. The quotient is nontrivial because its unital map goes to the field K. Otherwise lift a and s to polynomials using the evaluation range inclusion and take their quotient classes. The denominator class is nonzero, since a zero class would evaluate to s = 0. Evaluation of these classes gives z = ι(a) * ι(s) inverse. This bypasses the separate expansion and common-denominator argument for arbitrary z.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_triangularFieldModel_presentation
    (k : Type u) (K : Type v) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (hfg : ∃ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → K), IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range b) = ⊤)
    (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → K) (hx : IsTranscendenceBasis k x) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
      (p : (i : Fin r) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k)),
      h ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ i, (p i).Monic) ∧
      let A := MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + r)) k ⧸
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d r h p)
      ∃ (ι : A →ₐ[k] K), Function.Injective ι ∧
        ∀ z : K, ∃ a s : A, s ≠ 0 ∧ z = ι a * (ι s)⁻¹
